title: Polynomial length bound under composition
statement: Let $f$ and $g$ be functions on bit strings, and let $C,c,D,d$ be natural numbers. Suppose that for every bit string $x$, $|f(x)|le C(|x|+1)^c$, and for every bit string $y$, $|g(y)|le D(|y|+1)^d$. Then for every $x$, $|g(f(x))|le D(C+1)^d(|x|+1)^{cd}$.
